about: Web Push: notifications that arrive with the app closed. The page subscribes this device and sends what to notify (an open item's due time, push-items.js); a once-a-minute Worker job sends each when due (VAPID and aes128gcm on Web Crypto, worker/webpush.js), after checking the item still says so. An option (pushOn, this device, off by default) switches it on; while off nothing loads. Cloud app only.

files.line: { key: 'pushOn', label: 'Notify me when a task is due', sub: 'Even with the app closed. This device; iPhone: add to Home Screen first' },

needs: make the Web Push keys once, signed in to Cloudflare: node tools/push-keys.mjs (the private key goes straight to the Worker secret VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, the public key into app/src/push/vapid.js); commit vapid.js and deploy. Until then push stays off.
docs: push: what is notified and when is app/src/push/push-items.js (pushItems; stampOf is what must still hold when the Worker sends, read again from the item's document): make both the app's own. The switch is Settings > Features (option pushOn, this device, off); turning it on asks for the notification permission.

push: the Worker side is worker/push.js (routes /api/push/subscribe|unsubscribe|schedule, signed in with a role; the once-a-minute job runDue, at most 45 outgoing requests a run as the free plan allows 50), listed in worker/modules.js ROUTES and SCHEDULED through worker/push-route.js; wrangler.jsonc gets the cron trigger. Data in pushSubs/, pushDevices/ and pushQueue/, closed to pages (app/rules/push.rules). Optional var VAPID_SUBJECT (default https://<the app's host>). A tap on a notification opens ./#item=<id>.
